# Kerem Özdemir

> Sustainability and economics, Munich. A personal site with five ESG and finance instruments, seventeen single-job tools, eight case studies, notes, a CV, and a walkable 3D edition of the same pages.

Everything here is written by one person and published as static files. The figures the instruments print carry their source and reading date. The code behind the instruments is under the MIT licence unless a repository says otherwise; the writing is his unless a page says otherwise.

## Pages

- [Work](https://keremozdemir.de/work/): the instruments, grouped by what they are for
- [Case studies](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/): eight short accounts of a problem and what was built for it
- [Notes](https://keremozdemir.de/notes/): essays, with the reading behind each
- [About](https://keremozdemir.de/about/): who this is and the roles so far
- [CV](https://keremozdemir.de/cv/): the record, with a PDF
- [Contact](https://keremozdemir.de/contact/): two mail addresses, no form
- [Sources](https://keremozdemir.de/sources/): every citation the pages print, in one list
- [The walkable edition](https://keremozdemir.de/world/): the same pages as seven doors in a 3D world

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://keremozdemir.de/changelog/): what changed and when
- [Colophon](https://keremozdemir.de/colophon/): how the site is built
